name: Realm: meridian highlands (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic high plateau of pale stone photographed on location like a feature-film still - clean white rock, short grass, gatehouses and quiet valleys under a wide clear sky, calm even light and soft neutral tones; any magic is a faint white shimmer
notes: The neutral homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/neutral/ (set components.realm).
